focus_summary.purpose: MCP server providing 26 tools for Meta Marketing API interaction including OAuth, campaign management, ad operations, and insights
key_flows: OAuth authentication flow (login → token exchange → storage)
API request pipeline (tool → MetaClient → Meta API → response)
Error handling with exponential backoff retry logic
constraints: Backward compatibility with existing tool names and schemas
Meta API rate limits require careful error handling
Multi-user token isolation must be preserved
risks_or_unknowns: Insights tools refactoring could affect multiple consumers
MetaClient breakup requires comprehensive test coverage first
Response format changes could break LLM integrations

expected_improvements: 30%+ reduction in Meta API calls for repeated queries
Faster response times for cached data (ms vs seconds)
Reduced rate limit pressure
Foundation for offline/degraded mode operation
